launchBrief: Fictional launch brief: envctl 0.9 is a seamless upgrade, no action required. This marketing assertion is not authoritative when PR/test/policy sources disagree.

sources.text: Fictional merged PR 901 excerpt: new environments created without an explicit lifetime now default to 8 hours instead of 24 hours. Only newly created environments use the new default. No existing environment expiry timestamp is changed.
Fictional test excerpt: an environment created under 0.8 with a 24-hour expiry retains that timestamp after upgrading the controller to 0.9. PASS. Existing environments are unchanged.

Fictional test excerpt: a newly created environment with omitted lifetime expires after 8 hours. A simulated 12-hour overnight pipeline loses that environment before its final step. PASS: this is expected expiry behavior, not a deployment outage.

Fictional organisation policy excerpt: an explicit lifetime longer than 8 hours is allowed only when organisation policy permits that duration. A 24-hour request is not guaranteed to be allowed. Check policy with the organisation administrator; no universal override or automatic migration is supplied.

Fictional release policy note: the supplied excerpts do not specify CLI syntax, exact organisation policy configuration, recovery behavior after expiry, production SLOs or performance benchmarks. Do not invent these details. The launch brief is not evidence of compatibility.
